_comment: How hard an inferno comes. Rates are against vanilla's own precipitation pass -- one position per
chunk every 48 ticks -- so 1.0 reach is 'as often as snow would have fallen there'.
Raised from 1.0/0.25 after the first walk (Jonah, 2026-08-08). Two things were invisible at those
numbers: frost took minutes to melt, and almost nothing caught. The ignition fault was separate and is
fixed, but the rate was too slow to read either way -- a phenomenon nobody can see is tuned wrong
Harm is in half-hearts and sets how long a thing stays alight, so it is slow enough that somebody who
links in at noon has time to dig.
